thread:
Noah (Support): Escalation: HelixDx onboarding demo hitting intermittent 504s on embedding calls. Renewal review in 4 days. Ticket 501213.
Ivy (CS Ops): Acknowledge. Which deployment and model? I will draft comms and recommended mitigation.
Noah (Support): Dedicated US cluster, model embed-lite-quant. Peaks around demo times; sample log: `TS=2026-03-02T15:04Z REQ=ab12 route=/v1/embeddings status=504 latency=1450ms err=upstream-timeout`.
Renee (CSM): I'll send the initial customer note offering a short mitigation window + 500 free embed units. Can Sam lead the technical follow-up?
Paul (AE): Renewal meeting Fri 09:00 PT. We should avoid formal concessions; a credit + visible fix is fine. I'll join the remediation call.
Tao (eng-runtime): Quick look: signs of KV cache pressure and large batched requests coalescing. Short-term: route demo traffic to embed-lite-stable and enable tenant single-batch flag. I can flip flags for 2 hours.
Ivy (CS Ops): Comms plan (short): 1) Immediate ack + ETA (1.5h). 2) Apply temp routing and schedule 30m enablement. 3) Postmortem + action items before renewal. Renee, please send ack.
Renee (CSM): Sent. "We're on it — will apply a targeted mitigation and follow up with a quick technical session"
notify-bot: INC-501213 created; assignee eng-runtime; priority=P1.
Tao (eng-runtime): Feature flag applied for HelixDx: tenant_single_batch=true and demo route routed to embed-lite-stable. Monitoring now.
Noah (Support): Customer reports demo latency back to normal during mitigation. They said they appreciate the fast response.
Ivy (CS Ops): Action owners: Tao—investigate durable config and batch heuristic; Renee—run enablement + send status; Paul—use status note in renewal call; Noah—attach traces to ticket. Reconvene after the enablement.
Tao (eng-runtime): Will open RFC for tenant-aware cache sizing and batching tweak by EOD.
Ivy (CS Ops): Thanks all. We'll keep thread updated and draft renewal talking points after postmortem.
